items.issue: Morphic acquisition value: USD 3.2bn (Reuters headline, CLM-009002) versus USD 2.55bn audited IPR&D charge (CLM-009001).
items.evidence: LLY FY2024 10-K line 1570: Morphic acquired IPR&D charge USD 2,548.5m (asset acquisition, Aug 2024). Line 1039: 'We paid $3.35 billion in 2024 for acquired IPR&D primarily related to the acquisition of Morphic'. FY2025 10-K Note 4 line 1424 repeats 2,549. The two figures measure different things: headline equity/deal value (press) versus the amount expensed as IPR&D after allocating consideration to cash and other net assets. The 10-K cash-paid figure (3.35bn) is the nearest filing counterpart to the press figure. No filing statement of the 3.2bn headline was located in the 10-K text.
items.proposed_resolution: Keep both; add note to CLM-009002 and CLM-009001 that they are different measures (deal value vs expensed IPR&D charge, with cash paid 3.35bn in the 10-K); do not mark either CONTRADICTED. Keep CLM-009002 PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED until the Reuters article is opened (SRC metadata_only).

items.issue: Emraclidine impairment amount and timing (brief premise ~3.5bn in 2025 versus 4.5bn Q4-2024).
items.evidence: ABBV FY2024 10-K line 1010 and 1721: intangible impairment of $4.5 billion related to emraclidine; line 1878: pre-tax impairment of $4.5bn charged to R&D in Q4 2024, fair value $2.4bn, measured at 11-Nov-2024. FY2025 10-K cash-flow line 1444: total intangible impairments 847 (2025), 4,476 (2024), 4,229 (2023); the 2025 charge relates to Resonic and Durysta (line 1857). No conflict exists in the filings.
items.proposed_resolution: No conflict among registry claims; CLM-003058 correctly records the premise as CONTRADICTED. Add note that 4.5bn (emraclidine) is a component of the 2024 total of 4,476 only in rounding terms: the total intangible impairment (4,476) is slightly below the emraclidine headline (4.5bn) because the headline is rounded. Keep all.

items.issue: Lilly FY2021 acquired IPR&D: 874.9 (FY2021 10-K) versus 970.1 (FY2022 10-K comparative, and XBRL claim CLM-000178).
items.evidence: LLY FY2021 10-K lines 577, 596, 814: line item 'Acquired in-process research and development' 874.9 (2021) and 660.4 (2020). LLY FY2022 10-K lines 590, 615, 829, 941: line item renamed 'Acquired in-process research and development (IPR&D) and development milestones' with 908.5 (2022) and 970.1 (2021); the difference of 95.2 for 2021 is the added development-milestone component. This is a change in line-item definition, not a restatement of the same measure.
items.proposed_resolution: Resolve: upgrade CLM-009022 from PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED to SUPPORTED with note 'definition change: FY2022 line item adds development milestones; 970.1 - 874.9 = 95.2'. Relabel CLM-000178 (statement says 'acquired ipr&d expensed (asset acquisitions)') as 'acquired IPR&D and development milestones' where the value is 970.1, to prevent mixing with the 874.9 series.

items.issue: Takeda FY2026 restructuring cost cited as 150bn, 160bn and 170bn.
items.evidence: Takeda release 25-Mar-2026 (fse.or.jp 26032545020.pdf, re-read by A10): 'restructuring expenses of approximately JPY 150 billion in FY2026'. Takeda H1 FY2026 Kessan Tanshin (SRC-005015, re-extracted by A10, note *3, text line 649): 'restructuring expenses of JPY160.0 billion in Revised Forecast ... compared with the Original Forecast of JPY 170.0 billion'. BioSpace (SRC-005018) quotes ~JPY170bn. So 170bn is Takeda's own original FY2026 forecast (May 2026), not only a trade-press figure.
items.proposed_resolution: Resolve as a time series: ~150bn (25 Mar 2026 estimate) -> 170.0bn (original FY2026 forecast, May 2026) -> 160.0bn (revised forecast, Oct 2026). Edit CLM-005078 wording (it calls 170bn a trade-press report and orders the figures 150->160->170); upgrade CLM-005078 to SUPPORTED. Date each figure whenever quoted.

items.issue: AbbVie Ventures founding: 2009 ('Investing since 2009', web page) versus about 2015 ('Ten years ago, AbbVie Ventures launched', 2025 impact report).
items.evidence: Both statements rest on metadata_only snippets (SRC-009014). The impact-report PDF is fetchable by tools/evidence.py (6.5 MB, no text extracted); A10 could not obtain page text (direct download returned 403), so the sentence was not re-read.
items.proposed_resolution: Keep both; status INCONCLUSIVE (unresolved). Likely reading: 2009 is when AbbVie began venture investing (as part of Abbott lineage, AbbVie spun out in 2013), 2015 is the launch of the 'dedicated' strategic investment group; this is INTERPRETATION and must not be asserted. Next step: re-fetch the PDF with --store-raw and read page 1; open the AbbVie Ventures web page.

items.issue: ImmunoGen deal size: about USD 10.1bn (announcement, 'total value'), 9.8bn (consideration transferred) and 9.2bn (net of cash acquired); and CLM-003086 'USD 18.5bn of cash paid' for ImmunoGen plus Cerevel.
items.evidence: ABBV FY2023 10-K line 1105: 'total value of approximately $10.1 billion'; FY2025 10-K line 1702: consideration $9.8bn ($9.2bn net of cash acquired). FY2024 10-K line 1684: Cerevel $8.7bn ($8.3bn net). 9.8 + 8.7 = 18.5 is consideration transferred, gross of cash acquired; net of cash acquired the sum is 17.5bn. The AbbVie master report quotes 10.1bn for ImmunoGen without that distinction.
items.proposed_resolution: Add note to CLM-003086 and master_report L45: '18.5bn = consideration transferred (17.5bn net of cash acquired)', and cite 10.1bn as announced total value (includes debt/other), 9.8bn as consideration. No contradiction.

items.issue: OTTAVA 'first commercial installation' reported as completed on 2026-11-19, but the J&J release uses future tense.

The text read by A10 does not show a 19-Nov-2026 date. J&J master report (L30, L74, L84) treats the install as an event and derives 'about 24 months from IDE to first commercial install'.
items.proposed_resolution: Downgrade wording to 'announced the first hospital installation (Memorial Hermann)', keep CLM-000284 PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, add the release date from page metadata once confirmed; do not use '24 months to first install' until an install is confirmed (regulator-verified milestone remains the De Novo grant, which is supported by CLM-000283).
